premises.text: Customized instant manicures are a hassle for girls like Kendall
premises.evidence_span: getting a customized instant manicure is a hassle. Going to a nail salon is extremely inconvenient. It's also pretty pricey.

premises.text: The Nailbot can print custom instant nail art directly onto fingernails using a smartphone
premises.evidence_span: Nailbot prints custom instant nail art directly onto your fingernail using your smartphone.

premises.text: The Nailbot utilizes thermal inkjet technology for printing nail art
premises.evidence_span: We are utilizing Hewlett-Packard thermal inkjet technology in our early Nailbot solutions.

premises.text: The Nailbot's printed art can be easily removed and lasts a few days
premises.evidence_span: This art is also easily removed with traditional nail polish remover and can last a lifetime of your nail polish underneath, so likely a few days.

premises.text: There is a significant market of tween and teen girls who regularly decorate their nails
premises.evidence_span: 21 million girls strong in the United States, 92% of which decorate their nails regularly, and 14% of which decorate their nails daily.

premises.text: An augmented reality app allows users to superimpose images onto their nails
premises.evidence_span: we developed an augmented reality app where they can use the back-facing camera on their smartphone and superimpose images of their best friends, emojis, anything else from our app directly onto their fingernail.

premises.text: The nail services and care industry is a $15 billion market globally
premises.evidence_span: the nail services and the nail care industry is $15 billion globally.

value.text: Girls can express themselves creatively through customized nail art
value.evidence_span: creating an art marketplace for those to creatively express themselves with applications well beyond fingernail printing and painting.

notes: Traction metrics and crowdfunding details excluded as they do not support premises.
